style: A warm hand-made studio: kraft and linen grounds, chunky Caprasimo over Karla, an embroidery hoop that sews 'made to measure', services on kraft tags hanging from a wooden rail, rubber-stamp disciplines and a madder-red seam stitched down the process.

concept.idea: Client services done like tailoring: every job is measured, fitted and finished for one client. The page is the studio's workbench: an embroidery hoop, tags on a rail, stamps, a pattern sheet for who it is for and a price ticket for how it charges.
concept.signature: On load a needle sews the words 'made to measure' into the linen of the hoop, stitch by stitch. Down the process, a red seam is sewn as far as the reader has read, with the needle at its end; the steps sit on it like buttons. Tags swing on their strings under the pointer. Without JS or with reduced motion the words and the seam are fully sewn.

jury.note: Self-score from the /jury rubric and shoot.mjs evidence (0 axe violations, no horizontal overflow at 390 or 1440 with the sample and with long.json, no tap target under 24 px, skip link first and every focus stop visible, no colour-only primary hover, nothing moving under reduced motion). No blind critic was run for this batch. Warm and coherent: the hoop sews its words on load, tags swing from the rail and the seam is sewn as you read. The kraft texture triggers axe contrast 'needs review' items; the colours were checked by hand and pass. Long specialties make the stamps wrap to several lines.
